title: Google spared from ad-business breakup, but judge orders changes to how it operates | TechCrunch
summary: The Justice Department has spent years attempting to break up Google’s gargantuan advertising business across two separate antitrust lawsuits: one filed in 2020 focused on Google’s dominance in search, and a second filed in 2023 that specifically targeted Google’s ad-technology business.
